target_template: SELECT ?đơnvị ?địachỉ ?vịtrí ?điệnthoại ?email ?trangweb WHERE { BIND(${anchor} AS ?u) ?u rdfs:label ?đơnvị . OPTIONAL { ?u :officeAddress ?địachỉ } OPTIONAL { ?u :officeLocation ?vịtrí } OPTIONAL { ?u :officePhone ?điệnthoại } OPTIONAL { ?u :officeEmail ?email } OPTIONAL { ?u :officeWebsite ?trangweb } }
SELECT ?thủtục ?nộidung ?bước WHERE { BIND(${anchor} AS ?p) ?p rdfs:label ?thủtục ; :summaryText ?nộidung . OPTIONAL { ?p :hasStep ?s . ?s :stepOrder ?o ; :stepText ?bước } } ORDER BY ?o

SELECT ?nơinộp ?biểumẫu ?cổngthanhtoán ?ngườiquyếtđịnh ?đơnvịthẩmđịnh WHERE { BIND(${anchor} AS ?p) OPTIONAL { ?p :submittedTo/rdfs:label ?nơinộp } OPTIONAL { ?p :requiresForm/rdfs:label ?biểumẫu } OPTIONAL { ?p :supportsPaymentMethod/rdfs:label ?cổngthanhtoán } OPTIONAL { ?p :decidedBy/rdfs:label ?ngườiquyếtđịnh } OPTIONAL { ?p :reviewedBy/rdfs:label ?đơnvịthẩmđịnh } }
SELECT ?thủtục ?tómtắt WHERE { ?p a :AcademicProcedure ; rdfs:label ?thủtục . OPTIONAL { ?p :summaryText ?tómtắt } } ORDER BY ?thủtục

SELECT ?answer WHERE { ?rate :appliesToProgram ${program} ; :appliesToEducationLevel :UndergraduateLevel ; :amount ?answer . OPTIONAL { ?rate :minimumCohortNumber ?minimum . } FILTER (!BOUND(?minimum) || ${cohort} >= ?minimum) } ORDER BY DESC(?minimum) LIMIT 1

SELECT ?answer WHERE { ?band a :StudyYearBand ; :resultLabel ?answer . OPTIONAL { ?band :minimumValue ?min ; :minimumInclusive ?mi . } OPTIONAL { ?band :maximumValue ?max . } FILTER (COALESCE(IF(?mi, ${credits} >= ?min, ${credits} > ?min), true) && (!BOUND(?max) || ?max > ${credits})) }

SELECT ?levelLabel ?criterion WHERE { ?rule a :CertificateConversionRule ; :appliesToCertificate ${certificate} ; :appliesToLearnerCategory :StandardProgramNonLanguageMajorStudent ; :mapsToCompetencyLevel ?level ; :criterionText ?criterion . ?level rdfs:label ?levelLabel . } ORDER BY ?levelLabel
SELECT DISTINCT ?answer WHERE { ?rate a :TuitionRate ; :amount ?amount ; :appliesToProgram ?program . ?program rdfs:label ?answer . FILTER (?amount = ${amount}) } ORDER BY ?answer
SELECT ?label ?url ?entry WHERE { ?catalogue a :FormCatalogue ; rdfs:label ?label ; :webPageUrl ?url ; :hasCatalogueEntry ?entryNode . ?entryNode rdfs:label ?entry . } ORDER BY ?entry

SELECT ?label ?title ?number ?url ?form WHERE { ?entry a :FormCatalogueEntry ; rdfs:label ?label ; :listedTitle ?title ; :downloadUrl ?url . OPTIONAL { ?entry :listedFormNumber ?number . } OPTIONAL { ?entry :catalogueEntryForForm ?formNode . ?formNode rdfs:label ?form . } } ORDER BY ?title

SELECT ?label ?title ?number ?date ?academicYear ?semester WHERE { ?d a :Decision ; rdfs:label ?label ; :title ?title ; :documentNumber ?number ; :issueDate ?date ; :effectiveFromAcademicYear ?academicYear . OPTIONAL { ?d :effectiveFromSemester ?semester . } } ORDER BY ?number

SELECT ?trườnghợp ?thủtục WHERE { ${anchor} :hasResolution ?r . ?r :resolvedBy ?p . ?p rdfs:label ?thủtục . ${anchor} :caseText ?ct . OPTIONAL { ?r :conditionText ?cond } BIND(COALESCE(?cond, ?ct) AS ?trườnghợp) }
